description: This file defines a template class 'ConnectorType' within the WPEFramework::RPC namespace, which manages communication channels using the CommunicatorClient class. It includes methods for acquiring interfaces, managing communication channels, and accessing the engine. It also declares external functions for obtaining default and worker pool invoke servers.

classes.name: ConnectorType
classes.description: A template class managing communication channels for RPC, providing methods to acquire interfaces, access communicators, and interact with the engine.

classes.name: Channel
classes.description: A nested class within ConnectorType that represents a communication channel, inheriting from CommunicatorClient, with methods to initialize and deinitialize the connection.

methods.name: Aquire
methods.description: Template method to acquire an interface of type INTERFACE from a communication channel associated with a specific node ID.

methods.name: Communicator
methods.description: Returns a proxy to the CommunicatorClient associated with a given node ID.

methods.name: Engine
methods.description: Provides access to the RPC engine instance.
